# gaa-tha

> gaa-tha (गाथा, "story") is a storytelling-led digital marketing, branding, ecommerce, technology and AI agency founded in Gujarat, India in 2024 by Abhishek Khuthiya and Getansh Savla. It builds brands, websites, Shopify stores, mobile apps, SaaS products, AI agents, AI automations and ERPs; runs Meta and Google ads, social media, SEO/AEO/GEO and influencer campaigns; and onboards and manages brands on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, AJIO, Meesho, JioMart, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon Now and BigBasket.

gaa-tha works as one in-house team across seven practices — Brand & Creative, Growth Marketing, D2C Ecommerce, Marketplaces, Quick Commerce, Websites & Apps, and AI & Software Engineering — so a client can go from brand identity and a Shopify store or app to ads, marketplaces, quick commerce, automation and an ERP without switching agencies.

Every service, practice and guide page below also has a clean Markdown copy at the same URL plus `.md` (for example https://gaa-tha.com/services/shopify-development.md). The complete text of all services, case studies, guides and FAQs is at https://gaa-tha.com/llms-full.txt.

## Facts

- Founded: 2024, Gujarat, India. Serves clients across India and internationally (including Canada).
- Founders: Abhishek Khuthiya (Co-Founder, strategy and brand psychology) and Getansh Savla (Co-Founder, creative and consumer behaviour).
- Track record: 100+ campaigns delivered, 1000+ AI-driven content pieces, 50M+ total reach, 15+ client brands, 20+ websites built.
- Clients include: Charliee, CDS Stores, Nirav Machines India, Madhuram, Sipss & Bitess, Saurashtra Farsan, Rentastic Homes, NITS Overseas, Navami, Aathrr, Shailesh Construction, Ghanshyam Snacks, GSPS Chartered Accountants, New Rave, Kitcoz, HPMG Group.
- Builds with: Shopify, Shopify Plus, Hydrogen, Next.js, React, WordPress, Webflow, Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Node.js, Python, Firebase, AWS, Google Cloud, Odoo, ERPNext, n8n, Make, Zapier, WhatsApp Business API, Claude, GPT, Gemini.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Gujarati.
- Contact: digimarketing@gaa-tha.com · +91 97372 80309 · +91 77818 18981 · https://gaa-tha.com/#contact
- Social: Instagram https://instagram.com/__gaa.tha__/ · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/teamgaatha/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/people/Gaa-tha/61562303836796/

Brands people remember and content people stop for.

- [Cinema & Film Ads](https://gaa-tha.com/services/cinema-ads-film-production): Trailer-grade ads for the big screen, OTT, YouTube and in-store screens.
- [AI Cloning (Digital Spokesperson)](https://gaa-tha.com/services/ai-cloning-spokesperson): A consent-first digital twin of your founder, so you can publish on-camera videos without shooting every day.
- [Ecommerce Product Photography](https://gaa-tha.com/services/product-photography-ecommerce): Product images made to each platform's specs — packshots, lifestyle, infographics and A+ modules.

- [Catalogues, Presentations & Sales Kits](https://gaa-tha.com/services/catalogues-presentations): The documents your sales team actually uses — catalogues, company profiles, pitch decks and price lists.

## Quick answers

- **What is quick commerce?** Delivery of groceries, FMCG, beauty and everyday products in roughly 10–30 minutes from local dark stores. In India the platforms are Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon Now and BigBasket. gaa-tha onboards and manages brands on all of them.
- **What is marketplace account management?** The ongoing operation of a brand's seller account on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa or AJIO: listings, A+ content, pricing and deals, sponsored ads, inventory, account health, reviews and monthly reporting.
- **What are AEO and GEO?** AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) makes a brand the direct answer in AI Overviews, snippets and voice assistants. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) makes a brand discoverable and citable inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.
- **Is Shopify good for ecommerce in India?** Yes, for most D2C brands: it is hosted and secure, launches in weeks, and integrates with Indian payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree), one-click checkouts with COD controls (GoKwik, Shiprocket Checkout), shipping aggregators, WhatsApp tools, Tally and marketplaces. Guide: https://gaa-tha.com/blog/why-shopify-is-best-for-ecommerce
- **What does a Shopify website cost in India?** It depends on the theme, custom sections, integrations, catalogue size and content; the budget guide gives indicative market ranges by tier at https://gaa-tha.com/blog/shopify-website-cost-in-india
- **What are the best and hidden Shopify features?** See https://gaa-tha.com/blog/best-shopify-features-for-ecommerce and https://gaa-tha.com/blog/hidden-shopify-features
- **Custom-coded website, WordPress, Webflow or Shopify?** Shopify for stores, WordPress or Webflow for content-heavy marketing sites, custom code (for example Next.js) when speed, integrations or unusual features matter most. Guide: https://gaa-tha.com/blog/custom-website-vs-wordpress-vs-shopify-vs-webflow
- **Flutter or React Native for an app?** Both ship one codebase to iOS and Android; the choice depends on the team, the UI and the integrations. Native Swift and Kotlin are for apps that need deep device features. Guide: https://gaa-tha.com/blog/mobile-app-development-cost-in-india
- **What is an AI agent?** Software that is given a goal and tools (a CRM, a catalogue, email, an ERP) and decides the steps to reach it within guardrails and human approvals — unlike a chatbot, which only converses, or an automation, which follows fixed rules. Guide: https://gaa-tha.com/blog/ai-agents-for-business-guide
- **Custom ERP or Odoo / ERPNext / Tally?** Most Indian SMEs start with Odoo or ERPNext configured to their process, keep Tally for accounts where it already works, and build custom modules only where the business is genuinely different. Guide: https://gaa-tha.com/blog/custom-erp-vs-odoo-vs-erpnext-vs-tally
- **What is branding versus marketing?** Branding decides what your business means to people; marketing gets that meaning in front of the right audience and turns attention into revenue.
